props.name: progress
props.description: Controlled mode: progress in the range 0..1. When `progress` or `visible` is provided the bar ignores the controller and renders exactly what it is given.

props.name: visible
props.description: Controlled mode: whether the bar is shown. Defaults to `progress > 0` when only `progress` is given.

props.name: controller
props.description: Controller to follow. Defaults to the shared `loadingBar`.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render inline inside a relatively positioned parent instead of fixed to the top of the viewport.
